display.purpose: Chapter titles and closers. Bleed allowed.

components.name: Outline CTA
components.description: Square tracked text CTA. Inverts to Sand fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(214,209,196,0.28); padding:13px 22px; font-family:Instrument Sans,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#D6D1C4; text-decoration:none; transition:background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.35s, border-color 0.35s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#D6D1C4; color:#0A0A0A; border-color:#D6D1C4; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Clay CTA
components.description: Scarce Clay-stroke CTA for the current edition.
components.css: .ds-btn-clay { display:inline-flex; border:1px solid #8C5E4A; padding:13px 22px; font-family:Instrument Sans,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#D6D1C4; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-clay:hover { background:#8C5E4A; color:#D6D1C4; }

components.name: Waitlist field
components.description: Underline email field with Clay join label.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(214,209,196,0.28); } .ds-field input { flex:1; background:none; border:0; color:#D6D1C4; font-family:Instrument Sans,sans-serif; font-size:15px; padding:14px 0; outline:none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:rgba(214,209,196,0.74); } .ds-field button { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8C5E4A; background:none; border:0; padding-left:18px; } .ds-field button:hover { color:#D6D1C4; }

components.name: MENU
components.description: Always-visible header control. Overlay chapters live elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-menu { background:none; border:0; color:#D6D1C4; font-family:Instrument Sans,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; } .ds-menu:hover { transform:scale(1.08) translateY(-2px); } .ds-menu:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Edition state
components.css: .ds-state { font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 11px; border:1px solid #D6D1C4; color:#D6D1C4; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark gallery of oversized type, not a layout of cards. Each fold is one poster: Void Black ground, Sand ink, Clay as the rare accent. Display type is allowed to bleed. The custom wordmark is the only non-typographic mark.

Density comes from scale contrast — 11px tracked labels against clamp display — never from chrome. Motion is scroll-linked (wordmark dock, Lenis) plus honest UI state (waitlist swap/shake, menu panel). Copy is not gated behind reveals.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners, hairline rules, no pills
Wordmark as SVG mask, never typed

rules.name: The Four-Pigment Rule
rules.body: No fifth colour, no gradient fills, no grey-on-colour that is not Stone or a Sand alpha.

rules.name: The Bleed Rule
rules.body: Display may exit the viewport. Sections overflow hidden. Do not shrink type to fit.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: Display tracking is not tighter than -0.04em.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows. Hover is colour or a 3.5% Sand raise, never lift.

dos: Do use only Void, Stone, Clay, Sand.
Do show copy without waiting for a reveal class.
Do make closed editions look closed.
donts: Don't add button pills, cards, gradients, or a fifth colour.
Don't hide hero copy until the wordmark docks.
Don't report waitlist success for an empty or invalid address.
Don't invent colourways, prices, or edition stories.
Don't animate layout properties (padding/width) for hover chrome.
